# Boatrace Data Automation

Boatrace data is spread across proprietary formats, and collecting and formatting it takes time.
To make it easier to use for machine learning, we created CSV files with one race per row.
Because they can be downloaded over HTTPS, they are also easy to access from Agents.
Updated once a day (real-time data every 5 minutes).
If you need the latest information, please use another source such as [Boatrace OpenAPI](https://github.com/BoatraceOpenAPI).

## Data Download

All files can be downloaded with `https://boatracecsv.github.io/` as the root, using the following paths:

- `data/programs/title/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — per-race race name
- `data/programs/race_cards/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — detailed race card
- `data/programs/recent_national/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — national recent form (last 5 meets)
- `data/programs/recent_local/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — local recent form (last 5 meets)
- `data/programs/motor_stats/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — motor results for the period
- `data/previews/{tkz,stt,sui,original_exhibition}/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — pre-race information
- `data/results/realtime/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — near-real-time results, 5–30 minutes after betting closes
- `data/results/payouts/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — payouts, 5–30 minutes after betting closes
- `data/estimate/index/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — strength points (5-factor deviation values + contributions + total)

All files can be joined on the 12-digit `レースコード` (race code, `YYYYMMDDjjrr`) as the common key.

## Documentation

For detailed documentation, see [`docs/`](https://github.com/BoatraceCSV/boatracecsv.github.io/blob/HEAD/docs/README.md).

- [Data specification](https://github.com/BoatraceCSV/boatracecsv.github.io/blob/HEAD/docs/data/README.md) — schema, column definitions, and relationship diagrams for each CSV

# GithubAction

Hosts a set of scheduled small tasks on GitHub Actions: website check-ins, weather forecasts, Futu seed watering, weekly report pushes, plus a local Selenium tool for running check-ins.

## Getting Started

- [What is GitHub Actions](https://github.com/EchoHeim/GithubAction/blob/HEAD/GitHubActions入门.md)
- [Crontab scheduled task reference settings](https://crontab.guru/)

## Directory Structure

```text
.github/workflows/     Five workflows, the scheduling entry points of the repository
Selenium/              The Selenium check-in tool itself
  CheckIN/             Check-in scripts for each site + local runner
  CleanRuns/           Bulk-delete historical workflow runs (CDP version)
```

Hoerire/FlymeFreeform.description: An Xposed module that recreates Flyme's small-window interaction on ColorOS
Hoerire/FlymeFreeform.body:
On ColorOS, make the floating small windows at hand more convenient: swipe diagonally inward from a bottom corner of the screen to bring up a fan-shaped menu, slide to the app you want and release, and the small window opens directly. When you're done, tap outside the window to close it.

This project is an Xposed module. It adds no resident service and instead relies on hooking the system's existing freeform window and sidebar capabilities.

## Preview

## Features

- **Fan-shaped activation**: Swipe diagonally up and inward from the left or right bottom corner to bring up the fan-shaped menu. When you slide onto a slot, its icon enlarges as feedback. Release to open it in a small window.
- **"More" panel**: Split into "Favorites" and "Recent" groups. Favorites follow the settings and ordering from the system Smart Sidebar. Recent lists recently opened apps.
- **Close on outside tap**: Single or double tap outside the small window to close it. This behavior can also be turned off entirely.
- **Swipe up for mini window**: Quickly swipe up on the bottom bar of the small window to switch it to a mini window.
- **Shortcut management**: Apps, dual apps (clones), sidebar tools, and quick entries can be pinned in any mix, up to six items, with drag-to-reorder support. They are saved separately from the system sidebar.
- **Gesture settings**: The left and right entries can be toggled independently. "Trigger Area" adjusts the bottom-corner gesture recognition zone. "Hit Radius" adjusts the hit radius of the fan-shaped icons (40–140dp, default 140dp). While dragging the slider, the hit circle of each slot is previewed in real time.
- **Auto-pause**: Automatically pauses in landscape or game mode and resumes after exiting. The two can be disabled separately.

## "More" Panel

The panel has two groups: Favorites and Recent. Favorites directly follow the settings and ordering in the system Smart Sidebar, so whatever order the sidebar uses is the order shown here. Recent shows recently opened apps (foreground apps launched within the past 24 hours; apps already in Favorites are not repeated). The image shows the "All" panel as it actually runs in the module. The title bar, group order, and icons all come from sidebar data.

## Implementation

The fan-shaped menu is drawn by the module itself and attached to a separate floating overlay. The "More" panel directly reuses the "All" panel of the ColorOS Smart Sidebar, while the small window itself is still managed by the system freeform window manager. This way, windows, multitasking, and split-screen keep their native system behavior, and the module only adds one extra way to invoke them.

## Changes in This Version

- **Fan hit area**: Hit detection follows a single rule. The icon whose center is closest to the finger is selected, and if the finger goes beyond the hit radius, the selection is canceled. Arc inner/outer edge snapping has been removed, as has the "hold ring" hysteresis. The selection switches once the finger crosses the midline between two slots.
- **Interaction feedback**: In the original version, the selected item had only a very faint white outline, making it hard to see which slot was selected while swiping. Now the icon of whichever slot the finger is on is enlarged to 1.2×, so the selected position is immediately visible and you won't select the wrong item before releasing.
- **"More" panel**: Split into "Favorites" and "Recent" groups.
  - "Favorites" directly follows the system Smart Sidebar's user settings data and ordering: whatever order the sidebar uses is the order shown here.
  - "Recent" shows recently opened apps.

## Hit Radius Illustration

While dragging the "Hit Radius" slider on the settings page, the hit circle of each slot is drawn on screen in real time based on the current value (blue dot for center, dashed circle for radius), and the value is saved on release. The illustration shows the slider at 40dp. The default is 140dp (490px on this device), at which adjacent hit circles overlap heavily, so selections near the arc band are almost never dropped.

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

Till0196/ZeroWave.body:
# ZeroWave

A viewing program for digital broadcasting. It performs demuxing of MPEG-2 TS and MMT/TLV, decoding, deinterlacing, and display.

| Crate | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `mediadecoder` | ES header parsing, decoding of MPEG-2 / H.264 / HEVC / AAC / MPEG Audio / AIFF, and management of reference pictures defined by the specification. |
| `core` (`zwcore`) | The main body. Container formats, clock and synchronization, eight hardware decoding paths (VA-API, V4L2, NVDEC, D3D12, VideoToolbox, Android, AMF, QSV), audio paths (devices, passthrough, resampling), wgpu and GLES 2.0 rendering, deinterlacing, the program guide, and the player (subtitles, data broadcasting, layers, plugin loading; feature `plugins`). |
| `sdk` (`zwsdk`) | The plugin SDK. Plugin side (`plug`), host side (`host`, feature), message types (`layer`, `video`), font lookup (`fonts`), host-side canvas 2D (`draw`, feature `host`), communication (`net`), UI (`ui`), remote control (`control`), and settings (`config`). `javy/` and `ts/` are the Javy plugin and SDK for TypeScript. |
| `deck` | The desktop implementation of ZeroWave. Window (winit, egui), wgpu surface, and audio output (on Linux, libasound is opened at runtime; otherwise cpal). |

The transport layer (`mpegts` / `mmttlv` / `isdb`) is [coax-rs](https://github.com/Till0196/coax-rs).
Plugins (TSMF, data broadcasting, video filters, TypeScript layers) are [zerowave_plugins](https://github.com/Till0196/zerowave_plugins).

The package name of `core` is `zerowave-core`, and the name used when importing it is `zwcore` (`core` conflicts with libcore).

honjow/Koma.body:
# Koma

A comic bookshelf and reader for HarmonyOS. Put local comics, private libraries, and self-added book sources on the same shelf, save your reading position, and pick up where you left off.

## What it can do

- **Local reading**: import CBZ / ZIP, CBR / RAR, CB7 / 7z, CBT / TAR, image-based EPUB, and image folders.
- **Connect private libraries**: supports Komga, Kavita, OPDS, and WebDAV. Specific content formats and permissions depend on the server.
- **Add your own book sources**: install and update `.koma` sources from a subscription URL, or import them locally. You can search for books within a source, or use global search to open results from different sources.
- **Reading and offline saving**: single-page, double-page, vertical paged, and continuous scroll reading, plus chapter downloads, history, and continue reading.
- **Shelf maintenance**: manual and smart categories, chapter update records, cross-source migration, personal notes, and backup and restore.
- **Image plugins**: install processing algorithms from separate subscriptions, view their purpose, configure their parameters, and enable or disable each one separately.

For more about book sources and subscriptions, see the [Source library](https://github.com/honjow/koma-sources).

## Screenshots

| Bookshelf | Comic details | Reader |
| :---: | :---: | :---: |
|  |  |  |
| **Browse** | **Source management** | **Settings** |
|  |  |  |

## Installation

The minimum compatible configuration is **HarmonyOS 6.1 (API 23)**. The current build targets **arm64** devices.

[Official releases and changelog](https://github.com/honjow/Koma/releases/latest)

[GitHub Actions](https://github.com/honjow/Koma/actions/workflows/build.yml) provides build artifacts for the latest source code. Public HAP files are unsigned and must be signed by you before installation. For building from source, see below.

## Building from source

Install DevEco Studio and the HarmonyOS SDK required by the project, then clone the repository recursively:

```sh
git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/honjow/Koma.git
cd Koma
```

If you have already cloned the repository, run `git submodule update --init --recursive` in the root directory to fetch the dependencies. The shared reader and native dependencies are both in `third_party` and are pinned to specific commits by the repository, so you don't need to prepare a sibling directory.

Open the repository root in DevEco Studio, wait for dependency sync to finish, then build. You can also run the following in a terminal where the DevEco tool environment is configured:

```sh
# Agent Spaces

A visual workflow platform. Use a DAG to drag-and-drop orchestrate workflows, mixing AI Agent, code, database, knowledge base, human-interaction, and Mini App UI nodes, and turn repetitive AI tasks into reusable, triggerable, and observable automated processes. A workflow can be triggered by scheduled tasks, Webhooks, HTTP API, Issue events, or Agent tool calls, and can also be nested into other workflows as a sub-workflow.

The core is a **node-based visual workflow engine**: AI collaboration, code execution, and Mini App UI are just one type of node within a workflow, not standalone products.

## Features

### Workflow Engine (Core)

- **Visual DAG orchestration** — @xyflow/react topology editor. Drag nodes and connect lines to define execution flow, replacing hard-coded pipelines
- **40+ built-in nodes across 9 categories**:
  - **Flow control** — start / end / switch branch / loop+loop_body loop (supports concurrency) / variable_aggregate aggregation / set·get·delete_variable / run_code (JS) / run_python / loop_break
  - **AI** — agent_run invokes an Agent (six roles × six runtimes, including permission modes default/dontAsk/acceptEdits/plan/auto/bypassPermissions)
  - **Human interaction** — alert / prompt input / form (blocks and waits for user response)
  - **Display** — gallery_preview gallery / music_player / table_display / code_render (React/HTML) / markdown / sticky_note / file_display
  - **Database (SQLite)** — query / insert / update / delete / raw
  - **Knowledge base** — kb_add / kb_query / kb_delete (vector retrieval)
  - **Utility/string** — flatten_array / pluck_array_key / merge_arrays / parse_json / string_concat / string_split
  - **Mini App nodes** — show_miniapp pops up a Mini App UI in the flow, blocking to collect submitted user data
  - **Plugin nodes** — plugins can dynamically register custom nodes (server-side, client-side, or dual execution)
- **Composite nodes and sub-workflows** — loop is a compound node (with a scope boundary), sub_workflow…

# 하드트랜스 (hdTrans)

An offline translator that translates Japanese into Korean. It runs on your own computer without an internet connection, and it can be used directly with games and translation tools that used 이지트랜스.

Creator: 소쿠릿 ([Homepage](https://sokcuri.neko.kr/), [X](https://x.com/sokcuri))

You can try it right away in the [web translator](https://trans.kuri.kr) before installing.

| Japanese | 이지트랜스 | 하드트랜스 |
|---|---|---|
| 肉がジュージューと焼ける | The meat burns together with Jews | The meat sizzles and cooks |
| バイトに行く | Goes to baito | Goes to a part-time job |
| おっと、すまんね | Husband, sorry | Oops, sorry |
| 夢みたい | Want to see a dream | It's like a dream |
| くそっ！ | Poop! | Damn! |
| やったー！ | Did it-! | Yes! |

The 이지트랜스 results are from a [public comparison post](https://x.com/sokcuri/status/2111443062698451143/photo/1), and the 하드트랜스 results were translated with 0.8.4.
For more comparisons, see the [translation quality benchmark](https://github.com/sokcuri/hdTrans/blob/HEAD/docs/benchmarks.md).

## Features

It translates using dictionaries and grammar rules. Incorrect sentences were found one at a time, and people manually corrected the dictionary and rules. Each time a fix was made, about 100,000 lines of novels, games, and subtitles were re-translated to check that other sentences had not broken.

- Chooses between casual and polite speech in dialogue based on the context.
- If you list the characters and place names of a work, they are read as names, and honorifics, particles, and even spacing are matched.
- Does not use machine learning. The same sentence always gives the same result, and when something is wrong, the dictionary row or rule that caused it is found and fixed.
```

```
xiaofan6ya/MiraiHub.description: MiraiHub is a multi-platform aggregation gateway: one API Key can call models from multiple upstream platforms (WB, Trae Domestic, Trae International, Qoder Domestic/International…).
xiaofan6ya/MiraiHub.body:
# MiraiHub

> **Aggregate multiple upstream platforms into one standard OpenAI-compatible gateway.**

One API Key, many upstreams; one protocol, covering all models.
Built-in account pool, quota billing, risk-control sentinel, and real-time monitoring. Works out of the box, no external middleware needed.

---

## What problem it solves

You have accounts and quotas on several platforms, but they:

- Use different protocols (some only accept Chat Completions, others only their own proprietary endpoints)
- Have quotas that each expire, becoming worthless if unused
- Get rate-limited easily per account, while multiple accounts require you to manage rotation yourself
- Clients only support one protocol, so switching platforms means switching tools

**MiraiHub's approach: bring them all into one gateway and expose only standard protocols.**

```
                     ┌──────────────────────────────┐
   Your client       │          MiraiHub            │      Upstream platforms
  ─────────────      │  ┌────────────────────────┐  │   ──────────────
  OpenAI SDK   ──►   │  │  /v1/chat/completions  │  │──► WorkBuddy
  Anthropic    ──►   │  │  /v1/responses         │  │──► Trae Domestic
  Codex CLI    ──►   │  │  /v1/messages          │  │──► Trae International
                     │  └────────────────────────┘  │──► Qoder
                     │  Auth · selection · billing  │──► Qoder International
                     │  Scheduling · retries · logs │──► Loomy
                     └──────────────────────────────┘
```

Externally there is **only one set of Keys and one protocol**. Internally it automatically selects platforms and accounts, rotates accounts and retries on failure, and bills by multiplier.

---

## Core concept: the gateway is an extensible platform container

MiraiHub is not a gateway with a few hardcoded platform proxies, but **a gateway container to which platforms can keep being added**.

### What to do to add a platform

```
admin/platform/<your-platform>/

  gateway.py             Implement forwarding (chat…

Converts playlists from NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, Kugou, and Kuwo into lightweight audio M3U8 direct links, with built-in account management, favorites, play history, and an on-site player. ## Features

- **Playlist direct links**: playlists from four platforms generate signed M3U8 files that can be copied and previewed on the site.
- **Multiple accounts**: multiple accounts can be remembered per platform. Playlist cache, favorites, and play history are strictly isolated per account.
- **On-site player**: track-by-track playback, quality switching, auto-continue, cover queue, and a single volume control.
- **Quality fallback**: tries Standard, Higher, and High-quality MP3 in turn.
- **VRChat / 台 K**: links are valid for 24 hours by default (up to 48 hours). Room players need to switch to **AVPro / Stream** mode.
- **Interface**: collapsible sidebar, light / dark / system-following theme, motion transitions that respect the "Reduce motion" setting.

## Platform support

| Platform | Login method | Playlist parsing | Audio playback |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| NetEase Cloud Music | QR code / verification code / password / Cookie | Supported | Supported |
| QQ Music | QR code | Supported | Supported |
| Kugou Music | QR code | Supported | Supported |
| Kuwo Music | Password / SMS | Supported | Supported |

Kugou and Kuwo logins are used only to identify the account. Playlists and audio sources still go through public interfaces. Logging in does not raise audio quality, paid tracks cannot be played, and personal playlists, favorites, and play history are not yet supported. Playback links can also be generated while logged out.
